dvids.title: AFN Europe Report - September 4, 2026
dvids.desc:
On this AFN Europe Report:

U.S. service members in partnership with the city of Mons, Belgium, hosted the 25th annual Tanks in Town parade.

U.S. European Command kicked off the Protection Symposium in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Germany.

(U.S. Air Force video by Airman John Harbut)
